# ApexStryke

> ApexStryke helps businesses become more visible in AI-generated recommendations through AI visibility audits, Generative Engine Optimization, structured content, reputation consistency, and citation building.

## Official Pages

- [AI Visibility Audit and GEO Services](https://apexstryke.com/ai-visibility.html): Audit how ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity describe and recommend a business.
- [ApexStryke Main Website](https://apexstryke.com/): AI web design, business automation, AI agents, data insights, and digital growth services.
- [Services](https://apexstryke.com/services.html): ApexStryke service catalog and pricing information.
- [Contact](https://apexstryke.com/contact.html): Contact ApexStryke for an AI visibility audit or business technology project.

## Core Services

- AI visibility audits across major answer engines
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Machine-readable service content and structured data
- Business profile and reputation consistency
- Citation, authority, and digital PR strategy
- AI referral and recommendation tracking
- AI-powered website design and business automation
